title: WPMS/1800/2011 of AMARINDER SINGH Vs RAM SINGH and ANOTHER

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition No.1800 of 2011 (M/S)
Amarinder Singh
Ö Petitioner
Vs.
Ram Singh & Anr.
ÖRespondents
Mr. B.D. Upadhyay, Sr. Advocate assisted by Mr. Sunil Upadhyay, Advocate for
the petitioner
Mr. B.S. Negi, Advocate for the respondents
Honíble B.S.Verma, J. (Oral)
This writ petition has been filed to set aside the
order dated 9.8.2011 passed by Civil Judge (S.D.) Nainital
and to allow the application 61C filed by the
plaintiff/petitioner in civil suit no.103 of 2010 (Annexure
No.1 to the writ petition).
By the impugned order, application moved by the
plaintiff/petitioner (paper no.61-C) for inspection of the
spot and measurement by the survey Amin has been
rejected on the ground that since the Advocate
Commissioner has already submitted his report and site
plan, therefore, by not filing the report by survey Amin
would not adversely affect the disposal of the suit.
By a perusal of the report of advocate commissioner,
it shows that the Amin has shown his inability to
measure the land because of rainy season, therefore, so
far as the Aminís report is concerned, the Court itself has
directed the Amin to conduct the measurement of the
land in dispute and to help the Advocate Commissioner.

2
It transpires that the report of Advocate
Commissioner is not complete as per direction of the
Court.
The Court thinks that no prejudice would be caused
to the respondents if survey is made to measure and
identify the land in dispute.
Therefore, in the facts and circumstances of the case
and in the interest of justice, application (paper no.61-C)
is allowed to take steps for survey and file necessary
documents. As directed, let steps be taken by the
petitioner/plaintiff within a period of four weeks. The
respondent/defendant would be at liberty to rebut that
report also.
Accordingly, the writ petition is allowed. Impugned
Order dated 9.8.2011 passed by Civil Judge (S.D.)
Nainital is set aside.
 (B.S.Verma, J.)
 03.03.2014
Rajni
